title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
statement_md: Given a string `s`, find the length of the longest substring without duplicate characters.

hints.text: Use a sliding window `[left, right]` where characters within the window are all unique.
Store the last seen index of each character in a hash map.
When a repeat occurs, fast-forward `left` to `last[c] + 1` if it is greater than `left`.

editorial_md:
### Optimal Approach: Sliding Window with Hash Map

Maintain window boundaries `[left, right]`. When encountering a previously seen character in the current window, move `left` pointer to avoid duplicates.

- Time Complexity: $O(n)$
- Space Complexity: $O(\min(n, m))$ where $m$ is charset size
